channel_info.solar_50Hertz: The Solar Power generation of 50Hertz power grid in Germany. 50Hertz operates the electricity transmission system in the north and east of Germany, which it expands as needed for the energy transition. The 50Hertz control area covers Brandenburg, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt, and Thuringia, as well as the city states of Berlin and Hamburg.

channel_info.solar_TenneT: The Solar Power generation of TenneT power grid in Germany. TenneT control area spans central Germany, running from the Danish border in the north to the Alps in the south. The specific federal states and regions under TenneT's jurisdiction include: Schleswig-Holstein, Lower Saxony, Hesse, Bavaria, Bremen Parts of North Rhine-Westphalia.

channel_info.solar_Amprion: The Solar Power generation of Amprion power grid in Germany. Amprion is the Transmission System Operator (TSO) responsible for managing the high-voltage transmission grid in the western and southwestern regions of the country. The specific federal states and regions under Amprion's control include: North Rhine-Westphalia, Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate, Baden-Württemberg (partially).
